From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Exhibit reassignment and prorated billing addendum - TL add 120 GPUs

Jordan —

Following our call this morning, attaching a proposed addendum that does two things: (1) reallocates 120 GPU equivalent units from the US West exhibit to a new EU tranche and (2) introduces a prorated billing approach for the month of migration so TheraLabs is only billed for consumed throughput.

High level:
- Effective date: 2027-01-01 for the EU tranche.
- Billing: prorated daily for the migration month; credits applied if utilization is below 50% for any 7-day window in the first 30 days.
- SOW changes: updated implementation window and rollback clause captured in Exhibit C (see attached sow_exhibit_revised.docx).

Two asks for you: please confirm the EU region name (we used eu-west-2 in the draft) and whether your security team requires any additional KMS language for cross-region keys.

Attachments: redlined_orderform_v3.pdf (order form with highlighted diffs), sow_exhibit_revised.docx (implementation windows + cutover checklist).

If that looks OK I can route this to Legal for a quick sign-off and send a DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, North America
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0149

--

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clean draft. A few notes from our side after an initial review:

1) Proration mechanics: Can we flip to a simple "daily pro rata based on calendar days" model instead of the daily-utilization calculation? Our finance team prefers deterministic math for forecasting.
2) KMS language: TheraLabs requires explicit confirmation that cross-region keys will not be exported and that Redwood will support our BYOK key rotation schedule (we rotated keys last quarter, 90-day rotation).
3) SLA/credits: You're offering credits for low utilization — can you clarify whether credits apply to usage charges or to reserved capacity fees?

Legal attached two clarifying redlines in-line in the order form (see attached). If you can accept those or propose alternative wording we can move quickly. Also, Jordan here is authorized to sign limited-scope change orders if Legal approves.

Jordan Miller
Director, Cloud Ops
TheraLabs
jordan.miller@theralabs.com | +1 312-555-0199

Jordan / Legal —

Thanks for the notes. We made three concrete edits in redlined_orderform_v3.pdf:
- Switched proration to calendar-day pro rata (section 4.2).
- Added BYOK clause referencing support for customer-managed keys and a note on rotation cadence (section 7.4); the language also calls out that physical key export is not allowed by design.
- Clarified that credits apply to usage charges only; reserved capacity fees are billed as committed fees but we will offer a one-time top-up credit if the Customer reduces the reserved tranche within the first 60 days.

I've routed the updated order form to Contracts for same-day review and created a DocuSign envelope for Jordan to sign the change order. Link below. If Legal wants to tweak any language, Laura can do a final pass and I will pause the envelope until we have the final text.
